title: Per-game lighting semantics
description: What a light entity's properties mean in one game. It carries no geometry, no thresholds and no rules: everything here is vocabulary a consumer cannot derive from a map, and everything a consumer CAN derive from a map is deliberately absent. The per-game instance lives at games/<game>/lighting-semantics/lighting.json; a Game Profile may override it whole.

game_id.description: The game this vocabulary belongs to, matching the games/<game>/ folder that carries it.

units.description: Present so a reader never has to assume. Every length a consumer measures against this vocabulary is in the map's own units.

excludes.description: What this document deliberately does not carry. Required, because a vocabulary that does not say what it left out reads as complete.

fixtures.description: The light-emitting classnames this game ships. It is a vocabulary, never a whitelist: a map may hold a light classname absent from here, and a consumer reports that rather than discarding it.

keys.description: The entity keys that carry each trait. A trait whose key this game does not have is simply absent, which is what makes it unknown rather than defaulted.

undeclared_traits.description: Traits this game's shipped vocabulary has no key for, each with the reason. Saying it out loud is the point: a consumer can then refuse a rule that claims the trait, instead of publishing a confident default nobody chose.

family.description: How a human groups this fixture - torch, flame, globe, fluorescent, abstract. It is the reading of the classname, and it is what a rule is stated in terms of.

renders.description: Whether the entity draws something a player sees, as opposed to being an invisible light sample.

mount_declared_by_classname.description: Set only where the classname itself says where the fixture goes - `walltorch` does; `light_flame_large_yellow` does not. Null means the consumer measures it, and a measurement that disagrees with a declaration is evidence, not an error.

key.description: The entity property name as it appears in a map.

default.description: The value the engine uses when the key is absent. A trait read from a default is recorded as defaulted, never as declared.

steady_value.description: For an animation-style key: the value that means `does not animate`.
